bugs.what: Paginated room menus (p1/2, p2/2) reset to page 1 every time you re-enter the room or return from a submenu, so a remembered 'more in this room' option number can silently point to the wrong page.
bugs.where: e.g. The Hollow Throne, The Oath-Ground — Circle, Barrow Crypt

bugs.what: Directional exits are sometimes non-obviously asymmetric/looping (e.g. 'go north' from the Parade Ground led back to the Captain-General's Hall rather than onto the moor as expected from the bearings readout).

A gated NPC check (the ash-boy's will check to slip past the palace gate) had no visible alternate solution hinted at when it kept failing; the actual solution (Lord Marshal's escort token) was only discoverable by wandering to an unrelated location.
bugs.where: Marrowgate — The Servants' Way / Palace Gate

confusions: It's not always clear before a 'read/find the true record' action that it will cost standing with a specific companion (e.g. finding the founding ledger via wits at the Hall of Ledgers, or resolving the oath-stone) until the option text is already shown — fine once shown, but the framing 'a hit costs standing' reads oddly (succeeding costs you something) and took a moment to parse.
Travel-to-known-place lists get very long (30+ entries across multiple 10-item pages) once you've explored a lot, making it slow to find a specific far-off landmark by name alone.
suggestions: Keep 'more in this room' menu pagination stable/remembered per visit instead of resetting to page 1.
When a repeatable social check keeps failing, surface a hint after 2-3 tries pointing at an alternate route (the way 'go in (locked: ...)' messages already do for physical obstacles).
Add a search/filter to the travel-to-known-place list once it exceeds ~15 entries.
